title: Multi-Step Forecasting of Grape Berry Temperature based on LSTM Model with Feed-Forward Attention
abstract: arXiv:2608.29008v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate forecasting of grape berry temperature (Tb) is essential for enabling timely heat stress management in vineyards. In this study, a feed-forward attention mechanism integrated with a Long Short-Term Memory network (FAM-LSTM) was developed and evaluated for multi-step, high-resolution Tb prediction. Models were trained using environmental data from 2023 and 2024 at Prosser, WA, USA, and validated on 2025 summer data. FAM-LSTM was benchmarked against LSTM, GRU, RNN, and Random Forest (RF) across horizons ranging from 15 minutes to 72 hours (288 time steps). Two input scenarios were evaluated: nearest open-field weather station observations and in-vineyard microclimate measurements. FAM-LSTM consistently outperformed all benchmark models across all horizons and input scenarios. translated_title: 基于前馈注意力LSTM模型的葡萄浆果温度多步预测
translated_abstract: 准确预测葡萄浆果温度（Tb）对于葡萄园及时进行热胁迫管理至关重要。本研究开发并评估了一种将前馈注意力机制与长短期记忆网络相结合的模型（FAM-LSTM），用于多步、高分辨率的葡萄浆果温度预测。模型使用2023年和2024年美国华盛顿州普罗瑟（Prosser, WA）的环境数据进行训练，并在2025年夏季数据上进行验证。FAM-LSTM与LSTM、GRU、RNN和随机森林（RF）在15分钟至72小时（288个时间步）的预测范围内进行了对比评估。研究评估了两种输入情景：最近的露天气象站观测数据和葡萄园内小气候测量数据。FAM-LSTM在所有预测范围和输入情景下均持续优于所有基准模型。纳入葡萄园内小气候数据显著提高了较长预测时间范围的预测精度。使用露天数据时，FAM-LSTM的MAE和……（摘要原文在此处不完整）
tldr: 本研究开发的FAM-LSTM模型（融合前馈注意力机制的LSTM网络）在15分钟至72小时的多步葡萄浆果温度预测中全面优于LSTM、GRU、RNN和随机森林等基准模型，且引入葡萄园内小气候数据可显著提升长期预测精度。
en_tdlr: The proposed FAM-LSTM model, integrating a feed-forward attention mechanism with LSTM, consistently outperformed LSTM, GRU, RNN, and Random Forest benchmarks in multi-step grape berry temperature forecasting from 15 minutes to 72 hours, with in-vineyard microclimate data significantly improving accuracy at longer horizons.
